messages.subject: iidata Data Science Convention
parts:
Some of you may be interested in attending or getting involved with this event:

Hi D-RUG,

My name is Cindy, and I am one of the co-founders of the first annual iidata convention hosted on May 21st at UC Davis. iidata was founded on the ambition of several passionate students trying to reach larger audiences and pique people’s interests about the wonders of data science. It is planned to have the following events: (i) Workshops, (ii) Research Exhibition, (iii) Timed Data Analysis Competitions.

Event Info:
iidata Data Science Convention
May 21, 2016 10am-5pm @ UC Davis Conference Center
iidata is a one-day data science convention aimed at educating students about the new hot topic of "data science". Come join us as we will be hosting thrilling, fast-paced data analysis competitions, a research exhibition, workshops, and inviting guest speakers. For more information, check out our website @ iidata.net. See you there!

Cynthia Lai
